text:
Nora (Finance): FYI PartnerNova flagged a discrepancy on their May AWS marketplace invoice — they say a legacy reseller rebate was applied twice. Can billing confirm?
Ben (Billing): Pulling INV-2026-05-31 now. Quick CSV snippet:
```
invoice_id,sku,partner_id,gross,rebate,net
INV-2026-05-31,redwood.market.generation,PART-621,25000,5000,20000
INV-2026-05-31,redwood.market.generation,PART-621,0,5000,-5000
```
Ben (Billing): Looks like rebate line duplicated (5k + 5k) producing negative adjustment row.
Marta (Sales Ops): That duplicate came up in a partner migration last week. We flagged a potential double-import for PART-621.
Nora (Finance): Impact: 5k over-credit. Partner is asking for corrected invoice and GL note for month-end.
Ben (Billing): Proposed actions: 1) Void duplicate line and create reversal id REV-2026-05-31-1 for 5k, 2) Reissue INV-2026-05-31-R1, 3) Notify partner and Sales.
ReconcileBot: Automated check FAILED for invoice INV-2026-05-31 — duplicate rebate detected, rule DUPLICATE_REBATE_TRIGGERED.
Marta (Sales Ops): I'll reach out to PartnerNova with a short apology and note we will correct the invoice.
Nora (Finance): Please include GL account mapping (contra-revenue) and mark reversal for May close. Approve once JE number provided.
Ben (Billing): Reversal queued REV-2026-05-31-1 amount 5000 status PENDING_JE. Will attach JE when RevenueOps posts.
Marta (Sales Ops): Partner replied: "Thanks — please send corrected invoice and we'll reconcile."
Nora (Finance): Ok confirming follow-up required. Ben, ping here when INV-2026-05-31-R1 issued.
Ben (Billing): Corrected invoice issued INV-2026-05-31-R1, reversal REV-2026-05-31-1 applied, partner notified. Closing. :white_check_mark:
